criteria.text: Identifies that the comfort letter cut-off of 9 October 2026 is 9 days before the 18 October 2026 pricing date, outside the 3-business-day requirement in Clause 7(b), so a bring-down letter is needed.
Identifies the inconsistency between 61,750,000 shares in issue in the Prospectus and 62,250,000 in the Underwriting Agreement recital, which must be reconciled before pricing.
Identifies that 15% of 10,000,000 Firm Shares is 1,500,000 shares, not the 2,000,000 stated in the Over-allotment Option (Clause 4).
Flags the share-count inconsistency between the Prospectus and the Underwriting Agreement.
Shows the over-allotment arithmetic (15% x 10,000,000 = 1,500,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
